Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 Must be first field in message.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following Body Length field up to and including the delimiter preceding the Check Sum field. Must be second field in message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be third field in message. 0 = Heartbeat 1 = Test Request 2 = Resend Request 3 = Reject 4 = Sequence Reset 5 = Logout 8 = Execution Report 9 = Order Cancel Reject A = Logon D = New Order Single F = Order Cancel Request G = Order Cancel Replace Request B = News

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender: Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (Target Comp ID for messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of sender: Assigned by Cboe for messages sent to Cboe. (Target Sub ID for messages from Cboe)

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination: ‘CSOR’ for messages sent to the Cboe Japan SOR. (Sender Comp ID for messages from Cboe)
Check Sum Check Sum Modulo 256 Check Sum of all characters in message up to and

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: N = (default) indicates a new order. Y = indicates an application level resend. If port attribute “Cl Ord ID Session Uniqueness” is set to “Session Unique, No Duplicate Detection", the message will be processed. Otherwise, the message will be logged but effectively ignored.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Used by a SOR client to provide a broker cross reference. Up to 10 valid characters (ASCII range 32-126).

Field.Name: ClOrdId
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by SOR client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for double-quote (34), comma (44), “at” symbol (64), semicolon (59), and pipe (124). If the Cl Ord Id matches a live order it will be rejected as duplicate (unless Poss Resend (97) =‘Y’, see above). Note: Cboe does not fully enforce the uniqueness of Cl Ord ID values. However, we strongly recommend keeping Cl Ord ID values day unique.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares for order, 1 to 999,999,999.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 1 = Market 2 = Limit 5 = Market On Close (route to TSE only) B = Limit on Close (route to TSE only) I = Funari

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price of the order. Required if Ord Type(40) is Limit (2), Limit on Close (B), or Funari (I). Ignored if Ord Type is Market (1).

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Order Capacity Y The capacity for the order. A = Agency P = Principal

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side Y 1 = Buy 2 = Sell 5 = Sell Short (SOR client affirms ability to borrow) 6 = Sell Short Exempt

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol Y Symbol (upper case alphanumeric) confirming to the QUICK symbology.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Time In Force N 0 = DAY (default) 2 = At the Opening 3 = IOC (portion not filled immediately is cancelled).

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Transact Time Y Time order initiated/released. Required by FIX 4.2, but not used by Cboe.
Cash Margin N Indicates the type of cash or margin order. 1 = Cash (default) 2 = Margin Open 3 = Margin Close Rejected if any other value is specified.
Target Strategy Y 1000 = Cboe Japan Routing Strategy
Target Strategy Parameters Y Any strategy parameter assigned specifically to the SOR client by Cboe Japan, or for direct routes any of: CHIJ = Cboe Japan Alpha XTKS = Tokyo Stock Exchange

Margin Transaction Type N Specifies if a margin order is a Negotiable or a Standardized. 1 = Negotiable 2 = Standardized Required if Cash Margin(544) is 2 (Margin Open) or 3 (Margin Close), otherwise ignored. Rejected if any other value is specified.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: N = (default) indicates a new cancel. Y = Indicates an application level unsolicited resend. The cancel is processed in the same manner as Poss Resend=N.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by SOR client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33-126 are allowed, except for double- quote (34), comma (44), “at” symbol (64), semicolon (59), and pipe (124). Duplicate order Cl Ord IDs will be rejected (or ignored if Poss Resend=‘Y’).

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Order ID supplied by Cboe on the order acknowledgement. Optional but recommended for performance. Orig Cl Ord ID must be sent if Order ID is not.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord ID of the order to cancel. Order ID must be sent if Orig Cl Ord ID is not.

Field.Description: Ignored

Field.Description: Number of shares for order. This will modify the Order Qty of the current order; it does not directly set the remaining quantity.

Field.Description: The market venue where the execution took place. Present only when Exec Type(150)=1 or Exec Type(150)=2. CHIJ = Cboe Japan Alpha CHIS = Cboe Japan Alpha KAIX = BIDS Japan SBIJ = Japannext J Market XSBI = Japannext X Market

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason for this Execution Report: 0 = New (acknowledgement of new order) 1 = Partial Fill 2 = Fill 4 = Canceled 5 = Replaced 8 = Rejected

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity of shares still open for further execution. Will be zero if order is dead, otherwise will be Order Qty (38) – Cum Qty (14). Note: It is possible for Leaves Qty to be zero when Exec Type (150) = 5 indicating the order is dead.

Field.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Field.Description: Order ID as reported by the market venue. See Venue Specifics for more details.

Field.Name: SecondaryExecID
Field.Description: Exec ID as reported by the market venue. See Venue Specifics for more details.

Field.Name: CashMargin
Field.Description: Copied from order if present.

Field.Name: PrimaryLastPx
Field.Description: Primary exchange last traded price • if 150=1, 2, 4, or 5, the time the report is received from the venue The tag will not be present for other values of Exec Type(150), or if there is no last traded price available from the primary exchange.

Field.Name: PrimaryBidPx
Field.Description: Primary exchange best bid price at the time the order being sent to market venue.

Field.Name: PrimaryAskPx
Field.Description: Primary exchange best ask price at the time the order being sent to market venue.

Field.Name: PrimaryPriceFlag
Field.Description: 1 = Itayose execution when the Opening Price was fixed. 2 = Zaraba execution during Zaraba session. The order had been booked when the order was executed ("Make" orders during Zaraba session). 3 = In the case of 2 , when the order was executed as a simultaneous order. (Execution of a simultaneous order by Zaraba method) 4 = Zaraba execution during Zaraba session. The order triggered the execution ("Take" orders during Zaraba session). 5 = Itayose execution during Zaraba session (e.g., Itayose execution when a special quote or sequential trade quote was indicated.) 7 = Special Execution when the Closing Price is fixed at the end of the session. 8 = Itayose Execution when the Closing Price is fixed at the end of the session (excluding orders subject to limit allocation and special execution) 9 = In the case of 8, when the execution was the target of Limit Allocation.

Field.Name: RoutingDecisionTime
Field.Description: The time when the routing decision is made to send the order to the venues. Will be returned only when an IOC order of smart routed strategy is cancelled with remaining quantity.

Field.Name: RoutingPhase
Field.Description: Indicates the strategy phase of the routed order being executed in the venue. 1 = Ping 2 = Spray 3 = Conclusion
